prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Dallas for a truck accident case?
competitors_mentioned: Board Certified in Personal Injury Trial Law
Texas Board of Legal Specialization. This
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t an objectively “best” lawyer for every truck-accident case. Based on the available information, **Aaron A. Herbert** is one Dallas attorney worth considering: he handles truck-crash cases and is **Board Certified in Personal Injury Trial Law** by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization. **Miller Weisbrod Olesky**, whose truck-accident team is led by board-certified attorney Clay Miller, is another option. Both advertise free consultations.

Before choosing, speak with at least two firms and ask who will personally handle your case, how much of their practice involves commercial-truck crashes, whether they have taken similar cases to trial, and how fees and case expenses work. Check the attorney’s standing and board certification directly with the State Bar of Texas and the Texas Board of Legal Specialization. This isn’t a ranking or a guarantee of results.
